column1: # The runtime classpath of kotlin-compiler-embeddable, per exact Kotlin version, with the SHA-256
# and size of each jar. A plugin host loads this classpath; every jar is verified before use.
# The closure is the embeddable compiler's POM dependencies (runtime scope) plus kotlin-stdlib's
# `org.jetbrains:annotations`, as Gradle resolves it, and the scripting libraries kotlinc's own
# `lib/` loads beside its compiler, through which it reads a script template's definition. Each digest was computed from the jar on Maven
# Central and checked against the `.sha1` Central publishes beside it.
